name: Dynamic block
description: Adds a server-rendered Gutenberg block: one PHP class extending AbstractBlock from rtcamp/wp-framework (handles registration and render), plus block.json + edit.js + index.js for the editor side.

inputs.description: PSR-4 namespace for the block class. Default 'Inc\Blocks' matches the rtCamp skeleton.
Directory for the block class file. Default 'includes/Blocks'.
PSR-4 namespace for the test class. Default 'Inc\Tests\Blocks'.
Directory for the test file. Default 'tests/Blocks'.
Source directory for block.json + edit.js + index.js (the inputs to @wordpress/scripts). Default 'src/blocks'.

Compiled-output directory that WordPress actually reads (where block.json + bundled index.js end up after `npm run build`). Default 'build/blocks' matches wp-scripts' default `--output-path`. Override to the consumer project's actual build path if it differs.
Block slug, kebab-case, no vendor prefix, e.g. 'hero-banner'.
PascalCase class name, derived from slug.
Human-readable block title shown in the editor.
Vendor prefix for the block name, e.g. 'rtcamp' produces 'rtcamp/hero-banner'.

wiring.description: Add the block class to the Blocks module so the framework Loader registers it on init. If the Blocks module does not exist yet, scaffold it first via `wp-tooling add wp/module --name=Blocks --kind=block-dynamic`.
